FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Q1: Can I customize the scheduling rules?
FAQ.A1: Yes! Way of Roster is built for flexibility. You can define custom work hour limits, resting periods, and even specific employee exclusions.
FAQ.A2: Absolutely. Whether you're in healthcare, retail, or manufacturing, our engine handles complex round-the-clock rotations.
FAQ.A3: Yes, you can export your rosters to PDF or Excel formats with a single click, ready for printing or sharing.
FAQ.A4: Way of Roster is an automated workforce scheduling platform that uses advanced rules and algorithms to create perfect rosters in seconds. It eliminates manual errors and saves hours of administrative work.
FAQ.A5: Yes! While the engine generates the optimal schedule, you have full control. You can manually move shifts, swap employees, or adjust hours directly in the calendar.
FAQ.Q6: Does it handle vacations and sick leaves?
FAQ.A6: Absolutely. You can track all types of absences, and the scheduling engine will automatically skip those employees when generating the roster.
FAQ.Q7: How do I export the schedule?
FAQ.A7: You can export your monthly schedules to PDF or Excel formats with a single click, ready for printing or sharing with your team.
FAQ.A8: Way of Roster is a fully responsive web application, meaning it works perfectly on smartphones and tablets without needing to install anything from an app store.

LEGAL.PRIVACY_CONTENT:

We collect your email address and name during registration. We also store employee names, hours, and leave data provided by you to perform the scheduling service.

2. How We Use Your Data

Your data is used solely to provide and improve the Way of Roster platform. We do not sell your data to third parties.

3. Data Protection (GDPR)

For users in the EU, we comply with GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or delete your personal data at any time.

4. Data Retention

We retain your data as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the services.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@wayofroster.com.
LEGAL.COOKIES_CONTENT:
1. What are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us recognize your session and provide essential functionalities.

2. How We Use Cookies

  • Essential Cookies: Necessary for the website to function. These include authentication and security cookies.
  • Functional Cookies: Remember your preferences, such as your selected language.
  • Analytics: We may use anonymous analytics to understand how users interact with our platform.

3. Your Consent

By using Way of Roster, you consent to the use of essential cookies. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.
